TextField.description: a text input or textarea, addressed by its label

Select.description: a select or combobox, addressed by its label

Checkbox.description: a checkbox, addressed by its label

RadioButton.description: a radio button, addressed by its label

Button.description: a button, addressed by its visible text

Link.description: a link, addressed by its visible text

Tab.description: a tab, addressed by its visible text

MenuItem.description: a menu item, addressed by its visible text

RecordTable.description: a data table whose rows are addressed by the value in their key column
